newsitem.title: UK: Peptide gets IND status for typhoid vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Peptide gets IND status for typhoid vaccine.

text.p: Britain's Peptide Therapeutics said on Wednesday that it had been given investigational new drug (IND) status by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for a new oral typhoid vaccine.

"As a result we will shortly be commencing our planned Phase II clinical trial of this vaccine in the United States," Peptide Therapeutics chairman Brian Richards told an annual meeting of shareholders.
A company spokesman said it was yet to give any name to the new vaccine.
The company's share price was marked 28 1/2 pence higher at 362 1/2p as the announcement was made.
Peptide, one of the UK's leading biotechnology companies, said its cash and liquid resources currently stood at about 25 million stg.
